form.title: FTB 5805 Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Individuals and Fiduciaries

fields.label: Name or names as shown on return.
Social security number, Individual Taxpayer Identification Number, or Federal Employer Identification Number.
Line 1 — Are you requesting a waiver of the penalty? Yes
Explanation Line 1 of 2 . Limit of approximately 120 characters.
Explanation Line 2 of 2 . Limit of approximately 120 characters.
Line 2 — Did you use the annualized income installment method?
Line 3 — Was your California withholding not withheld in equal installments and are you able to show the actual amounts withheld per period and the actual dates withheld?

Line 3 . If “Yes,” enter the actual uneven amounts withheld on the spaces provided below. The total of the four amounts must equal the total withholding reported on Form 540, line 71 and line 73; Form 540NR, line 81 and line 83; or Form 541, line 29 and line 31 . Amount One of Four. Date: April 15, 2025. Enter dollar amount.
Amount Two of Four. Date: June 15, 2025 . Enter dollar amount.
Amount Three of Four. Date: September 15, 2025. Enter dollar amount.
Amount Four of Four. Date: January 15, 2026. Enter dollar amount.
Line 4 — For estates and trusts: Was the date of death less than two years from the end of the taxable year?
Part 2. Line 1. Current year tax. Enter your 2025 tax after credits. See instructions.
Line 3 . Withholding taxes. Do not include any estimated tax payments on this line. See instructions.

Line 4 . Subtract line 3 from line 1 . If less than $500 (or less than $250 if married/Registered Domestic Partner filing a separate return), stop here. You do not owe the penalty. Do not file form FTB 5805 .

Line 5 . Enter the tax shown on your 2024 tax return. See instructions. (110% (1.10) of that amount if the California AGI shown on that return is more than $150,000, or if married/RDP filing a separate return for 2025, more than $75,000)

Line 6 . Required annual payment. Enter the smaller of line 2 or line 5 . (If your California AGI is equal to or greater than $1,000,000 or $500,000 for married/Registered Domestic Partner filing a separate return, use line 2)
Short Method Line 7 . Enter the amount, if any, from Part 2, line 3 above.
Line 8 . Enter the total amount, if any, of estimated tax payments you made.
Line 10 . Total underpayment for the year. Subtract line 9 from line 6 . If zero or less, stop here. You do not owe the penalty. Do not file form FTB 5805 .

Line 12 . If the amount on line 10 was paid on or after April 15, 2026, enter 0 . If the amount on line 10 was paid before April 15, 2026, enter the result of the following computation: Amount on line 10 multiply by Number of days paid before April 15, 2026 multiply by .00019.
Line 13 . Penalty. Subtract line 12 from line 11 . Enter the result here and on Form 540, line 113; Form 540NR, line 123; or Form 541, line 45 . Also, check the box for “FTB 5805 .’’

Part 3. Line 1. Enter your California AGI for each period. Form 540NR filers, see instructions. Estates or Trusts, enter the amount from Form 541, line 20 attributable to each period. See instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25.
Line 3 . Annualized income. Multiply line 1 by line 2 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .

Line 4 . Enter your itemized deductions for the period shown in each column. If you do not itemize deductions, enter 0 here and on line 6 . Estates or Trusts, enter 0 here, skip to line 9, and enter the amount from line 3 on line 9 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 6 . Annualized itemized deductions. Multiply line 4 by line 5 . See instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 7 .  Enter your standard deduction from your 2025 Form 540 or Form 540NR, line 18 . Enter the total standard deduction amount in each column. See instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 8 . Enter line 6 or line 7, whichever is larger. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 9 . Subtract line 8 from line 3 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .

Line 10 . Figure the tax on the amount in each column of line 9 using the tax table or the tax rate schedule in the instructions for Form 540, Form 540NR, or Form 541 . Also, include any tax from form FTB 3803 . Estates or Trusts, see instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 11 . Enter the total amount of exemption credits from your 2025 Form 540, line 32 or Form 541, line 22 . If you filed Form 540NR, see instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 12 . Subtract line 11 from line 10 . Form 540NR filers, complete Worksheet One on page 3 of the instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 13 . Enter the total credit amount from your 2025 Form 540, line 47; or Form 541, line 23 . Form 540NR filers, see instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Part 3. Line 14 a. Subtract line 13 from line 12 . If zero or less, enter 0 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 14 b. Enter the alternative minimum tax and behavioral health tax. See instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 14 c. Add line 14 a and line 14 b. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 16 . Multiply line 14c by line 15 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 17 . Enter the combined amounts shown on line 23 from all preceding columns. Column (b). 1/1/25 to 5/31/25 .
Line 18 . Subtract line 17 from line 16 . If zero or less, enter 0 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 19 . Enter 30% of the amount shown on form FTB 5805, Part Two, line 6 in columns (a & d), enter 40% of the amount on line 6 in column b, enter 0 in column c. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 20 . Enter the amount from line 22 from the preceding column. Column (b). 1/1/25 to 5/31/25 .
Line 21 . Add line 19 and line 20 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 22 . Subtract line 18 from line 21 . If zero or less, enter 0 . Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
Line 23 . Enter line 18 or line 21, whichever is less, for each column. Transfer these amounts to Worksheet Two, line 1, on page 4 of the instructions. Column (a). 1/1/25 to 3/31/25 .
